This implies that Oblonganoside C may act as a modulator of Nek5 activity, potentially through the inhibition of Caov-4 cells. The integration of these relationships highlights a possible regulatory mechanism where Oblonganoside C influences Nek5 via its effect on Caov-4, which in turn is inhibited by K-252a. The observed scores support a plausible biological link, though the exact mechanism of interaction between Oblonganoside C and Nek5 remains to be fully elucidated.
